releases.body:
## Breaking changes

opencode-courier 1.0.0 gives a session the ability to start, message and wake other sessions, and no longer tells a model when to use it. How work is divided is yours: your prompt, your skills, your instructions.

- **Sessions are started only on request.** A model calls `courier_spawn` only when you, a skill or instruction of yours, or the task it was started with asks for a session. The split rule is gone from the skill, the role lines and every brief, and so is the `split: …` line a model wrote to announce its decision. A plain prompt no longer fans out by itself: ask for the sessions you want, or state your own rule in a skill. (#673)
- **A top session that has started nothing gets no courier instruction.** The pointer to the skill that every such session carried is removed; `courier_spawn`'s description says when to use it. (#673)
- **Role lines name a place in the tree, not a role.** "top of the session tree", "depth N of at most M" and "leaf" replace "root orchestrator" and "sub-orchestrator". Anything that matched on the old words needs updating. (#673)
- **The `courier-orchestrate` skill covers how the tools work, nothing else.** Its advice on planning, verifying and integrating is removed. It keeps one sentence on reports: a report is the session's own claim, so check it before relying on it. (#673)
- **Text you type into a spawned session stands.** The sessions above are told it is yours until you say otherwise, and a session above that thinks it breaks the job asks you instead of ordering the session back to its task. You may get a question where an earlier version overruled you in silence. (#676)
- **The report reminder follows what is owed.** After a session has reported, a later message or a repeat `done` from one of its own children wakes it and asks nothing more of it. A child's later `failed`, `partial` or `blocked` makes it owe a report again. (#677)

## What's Changed
* Have the opencode-release skill read the blocked-upstream issues by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/672
* Remove the split rule: a session starts sessions only when asked to by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/673
* A child's later done after its parent reported does not make the parent owe one by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/677
* Text typed into a spawned session stands as the person's by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/676
* Release 1.0.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/680


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.18.5...v1.0.0

## What's Changed
* Lead the README with starting and coordinating sessions from one by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/662
* Move the plugin API pin to OpenCode 2.4.1 by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/664
* Deny OpenCode's session interrupt in spawned sessions by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/667
* Pin and document what courier_stop leaves of a background job by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/668
* Count docs/reference.md's words without its generated version table by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/670
* Release 0.18.5 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/669


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.18.4...v0.18.5

## What's Changed
* Know the report reminder by its enqueued metadata, not only by its noted inbox id by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/659
* Deliver a courier_later message within about a second of its time by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/660
* Release 0.18.4 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/661


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.18.3...v0.18.4

## What's Changed
* Bring the docs in line with the code, and trim the reference by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/652
* Trim the reference and the plugin API notes, and guard the docs' size by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/654
* Move the plugin API pin to OpenCode 2.3.2 by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/655
* Release 0.18.3 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/658


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.18.2...v0.18.3

## What's Changed
* Tree panel: show again where the person opened it, and let a follow finish while sessions work by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/650
* Release 0.18.2 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/651


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.18.1...v0.18.2
